Submarine Sandwich
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, December 5, 2009 - 11:42pm

Ingredients




1 package hoagie buns
1 package honey style loaf
1 package salami
1 package natural sliced mozzarella cheese
1 small onion, sliced
1 small 6 oz. can tomato sauce
Italian seasoning

Preparation

1 Place open faced buns on cookie sheet. Spread tomato sauce on buns (just enough to cover). Spread meat and cheese on, then cover with rings of onion. Sprinkle with Italian seasoning. Bake at 350 degrees for 10 minutes. Then broil few minutes to make sure cheese is melted.
